クラス ToggleButton

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.awt.Component
      • jp.kyasu.awt.KComponent
        • jp.kyasu.awt.Label
          • jp.kyasu.awt.AbstractButton

  • すべての実装されたインタフェース:
    java.awt.image.ImageObserver, java.awt.ItemSelectable, java.awt.MenuContainer, java.io.Serializable, BooleanState
    直系の既知のサブクラス:
    Checkbox

    public class ToggleButton
extends AbstractButton
implements java.awt.ItemSelectable, BooleanState
    The ToggleButton class implements a labeled button that can be in either an "on" (true) or "off" (false) state. Clicking on a toggle button changes its state from "on" to "off," or from "off" to "on."
    関連項目:
    Checkbox, ButtonController, 直列化された形式
